entries.name: Wizard-King
entries.description: Each turn, pick one: STEP 1 square in any direction, capturing an enemy there. Or FIREBALL 🔥: blast the first piece within 3 squares in any of the 8 directions, friend or foe (the enemy King too, which wins the game), destroying it while the Wizard-King stays put. After a fireball, it can't fireball again on your next 3 turns (the badge counts down). Lose all your royal pieces and you lose.

entries.name: Heavy Artillery
entries.description: Each turn, pick one: STEP 1 square in any direction, capturing an enemy there. Or FIRE 💣: lob a shell over anything in the way onto any square 2 to 5 squares away in one of the 8 directions (empty or not). The shell destroys every piece on that square and the 8 squares around it, friend or foe, Kings included: blowing up the enemy King wins, blowing up your own loses. Reloading takes 5 turns, counting both players' turns, so it can fire again on your 3rd turn after firing (the badge counts down every turn).

customArt.description: Draw a large modern military style artillery cannon

entries.name: Hypnotist
entries.description: Each turn, pick one: STEP 1 square in any direction, capturing an enemy there. Or HYPNOTIZE 🌀 an enemy on one of the 8 squares next to it (not a King or other royal): it joins White, keeping its type and abilities, and you can use it on your next 3 turns. Right after your 3rd turn it turns back to Black. While hypnotized, its square is tinted violet, with a counter in the corner showing how many of your turns are left. The spell keeps going even if the Hypnotist is captured. A captured White piece that Black has taken over can be hypnotized back, and then it rejoins White for good. After hypnotizing, it can't hypnotize again on your next 3 turns (the badge counts down).

entries.name: Gardener
entries.description: Each turn, pick one: JUMP in an L shape like a Knight, over anything in the way, capturing an enemy where it lands. Or PLANT 🌱 a Plant on any empty square next to it (8 directions). After planting, it can't plant again on your next turn (the badge shows when it's waiting), but it can still jump.

companions.name: Plant
companions.description: Can't move or do anything, but it can be captured. Grows at the start of each of your turns: 🌱 → ☘️ → 🍀, and on your 3rd turn after being planted it becomes a random White piece (Heavy Artillery, 2009 Toyota Corolla, Hypnotist, Gardener or Zombie), which can act that same turn. (This is stage 1 of 3.)

companions.name: Plant
companions.description: Can't move or do anything, but it can be captured. Grows at the start of each of your turns: 🌱 → ☘️ → 🍀, and on your 3rd turn after being planted it becomes a random White piece (Heavy Artillery, 2009 Toyota Corolla, Hypnotist, Gardener or Zombie), which can act that same turn. (This is stage 2 of 3.)

companions.name: Plant
companions.description: Can't move or do anything, but it can be captured. Grows at the start of each of your turns: 🌱 → ☘️ → 🍀, and on your 3rd turn after being planted it becomes a random White piece (Heavy Artillery, 2009 Toyota Corolla, Hypnotist, Gardener or Zombie), which can act that same turn. (This is stage 3 of 3.)

entries.name: Checker
entries.description: Plays like a checkers piece. Moves 1 square diagonally forward onto an empty square. Or JUMP: hop diagonally forward over an adjacent enemy (the enemy King too, which wins) onto the empty square beyond, capturing it. After a jump it may keep jumping in the same turn (you pick where the chain stops). Reaching the far rank crowns it as a Checker King, and that ends the chain.

companions.name: Checker King
companions.description: A crowned Checker (not royal: losing it doesn't lose the game). Moves 1 square diagonally in any direction onto an empty square. Or JUMP diagonally in any direction over an adjacent enemy (the enemy King too, which wins) onto the empty square beyond, capturing it, and may keep chaining jumps in the same turn.

entries.name: Zombie
entries.description: Moves on its own and can't be moved by you. At the start of each of your turns (before you move), it shambles 1 square toward the nearest enemy. If an enemy is right next to it, it eats it instead, the enemy King included (which wins the game). Otherwise it steps to whichever empty neighboring square gets it closest to an enemy, and stays put if no step gets closer. Ties are picked at random.

entries.name: Queen
entries.description: Slides any distance in any direction. Royal: lose all your royal pieces and you lose.

entries.name: Archer
entries.description: Steps one square in any direction (capturing as it goes). Or shoots any enemy piece on the board, no line of sight needed, every turn with no cooldown. The arrow has a 75% chance to drift one square in a random one of the 8 directions (possibly off the board). It destroys whatever piece it ends on, friend or foe. Otherwise it lands on the target.

entries.name: Kamikaze
entries.description: Moves like a queen in all 8 directions but flies over any pieces in the way. Landing on an enemy makes it blow up, destroying every piece in the 3x3 area around that square, friends and itself included. It can also detonate in place instead of moving. One use only. Indestructible Castles survive and Doors take one hit.

entries.name: Calvary
entries.description: Travels up to 5 squares along a path of up, down, left or right steps (turning as often as it likes, never crossing a square twice). Every square on the path must be empty. It captures an enemy on the last square of the path, by moving onto it.

entries.name: Castle
entries.description: Cannot move and cannot be destroyed by anything. A wall.

entries.name: Door
entries.description: Cannot move. Takes two hits before it is destroyed. The first time an enemy hits it up close (from an adjacent square), that attacker is shoved to the square in front of the Door (toward the enemy). If that square is blocked or off the board, the attacker stays where it was. Arrows and explosions also count as a hit but push nobody. The second hit destroys it, and a melee attacker takes its square.

entries.name: Barbarians
entries.description: Steps one square up, down, left or right (capturing an enemy it steps onto). It can also kill any enemy in the 8 squares around it without moving, every turn, with no cooldown.

entries.name: Spear
entries.description: Steps one square in any direction (capturing as it goes). It can also kill any enemy within 2 squares (the whole 5x5 area around it), over anything in between, without moving, every turn with no cooldown.

customArt.description: A spear with a wooden handle and an iron head.

entries.name: Flash
entries.description: Slides any distance in any direction, and may make one 45° or 90° turn partway through the move. It cannot move through pieces, and captures only on the square where its path ends.

entries.name: Tank
entries.description: Moves one square in any of 8 directions, capturing as it goes. Instead of moving it can THROW an adjacent friendly piece onto any empty square within 5 squares of the Tank. It can never throw onto an occupied square or throw enemies. Or it can SMASH the ground, destroying every piece (friend or foe) in the 3x3 area around it; the Tank is safe. Smash has a 5-turn cooldown.

entries.name: Grenade Launcher
entries.description: Moves like a pawn: 1 forward (2 on its first move) without capturing, and captures diagonally forward. It never promotes. Instead it can lob a grenade at any square exactly 1 to 3 squares away in a straight line (any of 8 directions, over pieces). The blast destroys every piece in the 3x3 area around the target, friend or foe, royals included, and the Launcher itself if it is in the blast. 5-turn cooldown.

entries.name: Light
entries.description: Cannot move. Instead it can shine its light: a 50% chance that the opponent is blinded (cannot see the pieces on the board) for their next two turns. Using it takes your turn whether or not it works, and it can only be tried once every 10 of your turns. If the Light is captured the blindness ends.

entries.name: Pawn
entries.description: Moves 1 forward (2 on its first move), and captures forward and diagonally forward. Becomes a Flash on the far rank.

entries.name: Necromancer
entries.description: Moves one square in any direction. Once per game it can raise the dead: every EMPTY square in the 5x5 area around it fills with a Dead Body. Pieces already there are untouched, but they are hemmed in. Dead Bodies never move, block movement, and can be captured.

companions.name: Dead Body
companions.description: Raised by the Necromancer. Never moves and blocks the square, but can be captured.

entries.name: 2009 Toyota Corolla
entries.description: Moves like a Rook. Or CHARGE 🚗💨: drive any distance in a straight line (up, down, left or right) right through other pieces, running over every piece it passes and the one it lands on: friend or foe, the enemy King included. It can't charge through your own King. After a charge it can only make normal Rook moves for your next 3 turns (the badge counts down). If a piece survives being hit, the car drives over it; if the piece on the final square survives, the car stops on the last empty square before it.

companions.name: Pawn
companions.description: Looks and moves exactly like a Pawn: 1 forward (2 on its first move), captures diagonally forward, and becomes a Queen on the far rank. Secretly a 2009 Toyota Corolla! On your turn, select it and click it again to throw a smoke bomb and Reveal 💨, turning into a 2009 Toyota Corolla (rook moves and charge, ready to use). Revealing is free: you then take another turn with any piece.

entries.name: Wizard
entries.description: Each turn, pick one: STEP 1 square in any direction, capturing an enemy there. FIREBALL 🔥: blast the first piece within 3 squares in any of the 8 directions, friend or foe (never your own King), destroying it while the Wizard stays put. TELEPORT ✨: jump to any empty square, or swap places with one of your own pieces (never onto an enemy). Fireball and Teleport each have their own cooldown: after use, that ability is unavailable for your next 3 turns (the badge shows 🔥/✨ and turns left).

companions.name: Pawn
companions.description: Looks and moves exactly like a Pawn: 1 forward (2 on its first move), captures diagonally forward, and becomes a Queen on the far rank. Secretly a Wizard! On your turn, select it and click it again to throw a smoke bomb and Reveal 💨, turning into a Wizard (step, fireball and teleport, both ready to use). Revealing is free: you then take another turn with any piece.

entries.name: Knight
entries.description: Looks and moves exactly like a Knight (jumps in an L shape, over anything in the way). Secretly a Kamikaze-Knight! On your turn, instead of moving, select it and click it again to Self-destruct 💥: it and every piece in the 3×3 square around it are destroyed, friend or foe, Kings included. (If both Kings go, it's a draw.) Being captured does not set it off.

companions.name: Pawn
companions.description: Looks and moves exactly like a Pawn: 1 forward (2 on its first move), captures diagonally forward, and becomes a Queen on the far rank. Secretly a Kamikaze-Knight! On your turn, select it and click it again to throw a smoke bomb and Reveal 💨, turning into a Kamikaze-Knight (knight jumps and self-destruct). Revealing is free: you then take another turn with any piece.

entries.name: Catapult
entries.description: Slides any distance in a straight line, like a rook. FLING: instead of moving, it launches any piece (either side) on one of the 8 squares around it. The piece flies straight away from the catapult, over anything in between, and lands 1 to 4 squares further on. It can land on an empty square or crush one of the Catapult's enemies there, kings included, but never on a friend of the Catapult. If the crushed piece survives, the flung piece stays where it was.

entries.name: Necromancer
entries.description: Slides any distance in any direction, like a queen. RAISE DEAD: instead of moving, she brings back one of her captured pieces (never a king) on an empty square next to her, with all its real abilities. Then she needs 4 turns to recharge (the badge counts down). Raised pieces are Undead (green): they crumble to dust after 3 turns, and once dead they stay dead.

companions.name: Undead Pawn
companions.description: Raised by the Necromancer. Moves 1 forward (2 on its first move) and captures diagonally forward. Becomes a Queen on the far rank. DETONATE 💥: instead of moving, it can blow itself up (click the pawn, then its own square), destroying itself and every piece on the 8 squares around it, from either side, kings included. Pawns caught in a blast do not explode. Crumbles to dust after 3 turns (the ☠ badge counts down), and can't be raised again.

companions.name: Undead Knight
companions.description: Raised by the Necromancer. Jumps in an L shape, over anything in the way. Crumbles to dust after 3 turns (the ☠ badge counts down), and can't be raised again.

companions.name: Undead Wizard
companions.description: Raised by the Necromancer. Each turn, picks one spell. STEP: moves 1 square in any direction, capturing normally. FIREBALL 🔥: destroys the first enemy in any straight or diagonal line within 3 squares (not kings or other royals), then needs 3 turns to recharge (the badge counts down). OPEN PORTAL 🌀: places a pair of linked portals on any two empty squares (two clicks, one turn). Any piece, from either side, that ends a move on a portal is sent to the other one, and whatever is standing there is destroyed (telefrag), friend or foe, even a king. Each wizard has one pair; opening a new pair closes the old one, and its portals vanish if the wizard dies. Crumbles to dust after 3 turns (the ☠ badge counts down), and can't be raised again.

companions.name: Undead Catapult
companions.description: Raised by the Necromancer. Slides any distance in a straight line, like a rook. FLING: instead of moving, it launches any piece (either side) on one of the 8 squares around it. The piece flies straight away from the catapult, over anything in between, and lands 1 to 4 squares further on. It can land on an empty square or crush one of the Catapult's enemies there, kings included, but never on a friend of the Catapult. If the crushed piece survives, the flung piece stays where it was. Crumbles to dust after 3 turns (the ☠ badge counts down), and can't be raised again.

companions.name: Undead Queen
companions.description: Raised by the Necromancer. Slides any distance in any direction. Crumbles to dust after 3 turns (the ☠ badge counts down), and can't be raised again.

entries.name: Wizard
entries.description: Each turn, picks one spell. STEP: moves 1 square in any direction, capturing normally. FIREBALL 🔥: destroys the first enemy in any straight or diagonal line within 3 squares (not kings or other royals), then needs 3 turns to recharge (the badge counts down). OPEN PORTAL 🌀: places a pair of linked portals on any two empty squares (two clicks, one turn). Any piece, from either side, that ends a move on a portal is sent to the other one, and whatever is standing there is destroyed (telefrag), friend or foe, even a king. Each wizard has one pair; opening a new pair closes the old one, and its portals vanish if the wizard dies.

entries.name: Pawn
entries.description: Moves 1 forward (2 on its first move) and captures diagonally forward. Becomes a Queen on the far rank. DETONATE 💥: instead of moving, it can blow itself up (click the pawn, then its own square), destroying itself and every piece on the 8 squares around it, from either side, kings included. Pawns caught in a blast do not explode.

entries.name: Wayfinder
entries.description: Moves 1 square forward, or captures 1 square diagonally forward. Reaching White’s back rank wins the game for Black.

entries.name: Creeper
entries.description: Moves 1 square in any direction. After it moves, a fuse counts down for 2 full rounds (4 moves by both players); then it destroys every piece in the surrounding 3×3 area, including itself and allies.

entries.name: Swapper
entries.description: Moves 1 square in any direction, or trades places with any other piece on the board, friend or foe.

entries.name: Teleporter
entries.description: Moves 1 square in any direction, or teleports to any empty square or captures an enemy piece anywhere on the board.
